notes.title: Mountain is getting a big update on 4/20
notes.content:
Hi friends. [b]First thing[/b] - thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for your support of this game. The fact that anyone might even read this is the most amazing thing to me, I am very grateful for your attention in this brief time we have on the planet.

[b]Second thing[/b] - there is a [b]big update[/b] coming. You all deserve a big refresh and it's going to be happening on [b]April 20th[/b] and of course it will be [b]free[/b]. New things to look forward to:

	•	Big performance improvement
	•	Complete asset refresh - better graphics all round
	•	More varied & realistic vegetation
	•	Better Mountain shapes
	•	3X as many things can fall from space
	•	All things now have sound interaction
	•	31 Steam Achievements
	•	Steam Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons, Profile BGs.

[b]Third thing[/b] - I have a totally new game coming out on Friday April 21st - for Mac & PC - called [url=http://www.everything-game.com/]Everything[/url]. You can check out the gameplay trailer [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HdJk8ROpuEo]here[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/582270]wishlist it now here[/url]. 

Your support of Mountain made this new game possible - and you will all be getting vouchers for it (which also apply to the launch discount). The vouchers are actually worth more than the price of Mountain - I just really wanted to say thank you. You have enabled me to keep my work independent.  

If you love Mountain, Everything is a much larger exploration of the same ideas. I really worked hard on it and I hope you enjoy it. So don't forget to  [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/582270]wishlist it![/url]

Thank you all again. 

David

Find me on [url=https://twitter.com/davidoreilly] twitter [/url] / [url=https://www.facebook.com/thedavidoreilly] facebook [/url]
